mapper.select: select asr.id,asr.module_prefix,asr.tag_name,asr.req_path,asr.req_method,asr.summary,asr.request_class,asr.response_class,asr.class_name,asr.method_name,asr.login_allow_access from security_api_resource asr left join ( select satm.id ,satm.api_id ,satm.module_prefix ,COALESCE(satmc.datasource ,satm.datasource) as datasource,satm.table_name,satm.field_config from security_api_table_model satm left join security_api_table_model_config satmc on satmc.table_model_id = satm.id ) tb on tb.api_id = asr.id where tb.module_prefix = #{modulePrefix} and tb.datasource = #{datasource} and tb.table_name = #{tableName} and asr.deleted = 0

select satm.id ,satm.api_id ,satm.module_prefix ,COALESCE(satmc.datasource ,satm.datasource) as datasource,satm.table_name,satm.field_config, satm.tenant_id,satm.create_op,satm.create_time,satm.modify_op,satm.modify_time from security_api_table_model satm left join security_api_table_model_config satmc on satmc.table_model_id = satm.id where satm.api_id in #{item}
